title: One of Us Is Lying
author: Karen M. McManus
summary: Five students go to detention, but only four leave alive when the school's gossip-app creator collapses and dies. Each of the four had a secret he was about to expose.
readIf: you want a quick, twisty teen whodunit with a very bingeable pace.
skipIf: you prefer your mysteries more realistic and grown up, since the plot relies on contrivance.

pairings.reason: Another young-adult mystery with a smart teen sleuth, a small town and a case that refuses to stay closed.
A grown-up version of a group of suspects with secrets and a death among them.
